literature_notes: All four ledger lines concern the intracellular N-terminus (residues 1–11) and intracellular C-terminus (residues 272–321) of PLPPR5/PRG5. L1 reports mTurquoise/eYFP fused to either terminus of full-length PRG5 for FLIM-FRET; both termini are intracellular, so neither constitutes a surface tag site. L2 reports that N-terminal eGFP abolishes membrane localization and filopodia induction — this is an abrogates_function result for the intracellular N-terminus, placed in other_positions. L3 reports a spacer-rescued N-terminal eGFP construct that restores membrane insertion; the N-terminus remains intracellular (topology residues 1–11), so this is a tolerated intracellular tag, not a surface tag site. L4 reports C-terminal eGFP and FLAG constructs (PRG5-eGFP, PRG5-FLAG) that are expressed and co-immunoprecipitate in HEK293T cells; the C-terminus (residues 272–321) is intracellular, so these are tolerated intracellular tags. No ledger line reports any insertion in the three extracellular loops (EC1: 31–65, EC2: 144–195, EC3: 242–250). Zero surface tag sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: eGFP fused directly to the N-terminus of full-length PRG5 prevents membrane localization and filopodia induction; N-terminus is intracellular (residues 1–11).
N-terminal eGFP with a GS-rich spacer restores membrane insertion and is tolerated, but the N-terminus (residues 1–11) is intracellular, not a surface site.
C-terminal eGFP and FLAG tags (PRG5-eGFP, PRG5-FLAG) are expressed and functional for co-IP in HEK293T cells, but the C-terminus (residues 272–321) is intracellular.
